Occupation interventions propose whole-path predictor certificates with an exponential conditional-variance acquisition barrier For a finite hidden controlled jump process with k visible labels, a repeatable hidden preparation, bounded target/probe exit rates R, a well-posed predictable visible-history controller and a frozen bounded-hazard predictor, independent random occupation time U on [0,T] defines D=E||Q^(J_U)E(X_U,:)-vhat(U,H_U)||_2^2. D has units rate squared. The source reconstructs a coupling bound TV(P_visible,P_predictor)<=min{1,delta_init+T sqrt((k-1)D)} for the entire visible path including jump times. No stationary distribution, hidden dimension, minimum label mass or training/deployment density ratio is supplied. This is an internally proved source candidate, not physical validation.

Fresh reset/replay and random stopping reproduce the identical unprobed controller law before every moment experiment; probe choice is causally isolated until the stop. The initial action tag and pre-stop predictor are held fixed during short probes. Compatible microscopic gains must actually obey simultaneous off-diagonal products; sequential pulses are a different operation. Selective within-label neutrality or all-microscopic-event activity sensing is load-bearing. Nonstationary same-state Gram and predictor cross moments acquire D without microscopic reconstruction, hidden-state cloning or rare-label division. Predictor computation, reset cost, product synthesis, timing, noise and optimization error are charged.

Time-jet interpolation and finite-confidence moment bounds give a conservative Dcert; bounded l1 synthesis and PSD inflation permit coefficients fitted on the same data. A non-PSD or unhelpful result is inconclusive, and numerical zero is not exact closure. Rate normalization uses tau=RT and D_normalized=D/R^2. Statistical costs can have large epsilon^-4/epsilon^-8 and horizon factors. The four-label passive/active separation uses a stronger disclosed active interface and exponential hidden dimension; it is not a generic experimental advantage. The complete noisy unknown-simulator assay and a consequential physical probe law have not been demonstrated.

The raw residual is sufficient but incomplete: D_raw=D_cond+E||r_U-E[r_U|H_U]||^2. A perfect visible predictor can have D_raw>0 (the supplied four-state fixture gives 1/64). In a six-label reducible episodic family with horizon T=O(m), a common known generator/probe library and an unknown initial hidden context/sign association, the perfect null has D_cond=0 while alternatives have D_cond>1/(256T) and path error>1/32. Even revealing the full hidden context/sign after every reset leaves an Omega(2^(m/2)) reset lower bound for the specified accurate estimator or sound certificate that recognizes perfect predictors. This targets preparation association; it is not a bound under a known small conditional representation, known preparation, uniform mixing or cheap physical realization of exponentially described alternatives.

Observable predictable critics give lower discrepancy witnesses. Independent posterior replicas conditional on the VISIBLE history give conditional mean squares. Ordinary independent future branches from the SAME hidden X_U instead give the raw same-state square; cloning does not supply posterior replicas. A supplied finite conditional closure with justified error permits an upper certificate via tagged first moments and mass truncation, with its validation/acquisition charged. A small unvalidated representation cannot be substituted for this promise.

Family fit: a scoped continuation of N713 calibrated closure response and N718 heterogeneous product-gain nonstationary residual acquisition. It changes to the controller's on-policy occupation law and a frozen history predictor, retaining the original product/neutrality interfaces. It neither validates their scientific claims nor supplies tolerant testing, counterfactual controllers or an infinite-horizon theorem. N728 has a distinct quantum filter/copy interface. Hilder/Sharma coarse-graining and functional-inequality comparisons are credited source audits; exact combination priority remains UNKNOWN.
